content.text:
Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the POSTed bulk-edit loop (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`, so all edits commit atomically and roll back together if any error occurs. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests, 0 failures.
